en.text:
<stasis/>Stasis arrows create Large <stasis/>Stasis Crystals on impact, and <stasis/>Freeze on direct hits. 

In PvP, direct hits apply <stasis/><pvp [50 Slow] /> for 1 second (2 seconds with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance).

This weapon deals 50% increased damage to <stasis/>Frozen enemies and <stasis/>Stasis Crystals (damage increase stacks with <stasis/>Whisper of Rending).
